title: Floating toolbar: vertical FAB
purpose: Check the vertical paired floating toolbar and its FAB placement and collapse behavior.
changes: Added a vertical paired-toolbar example and verified expanded and collapsed top/bottom FAB geometry.
steps: Turn on Vertical near the top. The toolbar should stand vertically with its plus button below the action surface.
Turn on Start. The plus button moves above the action surface; turn Start off to return it below.
Turn Expanded off. The toolbar contracts and the plus button grows; turn Expanded on to restore it.
Try RTL and Vibrant. Vertical top/bottom placement should remain stable and the colors should change with Vibrant. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the issue and your device.
expected: The vertical FAB moves between top and bottom, grows when collapsed and returns when expanded; RTL does not swap top and bottom.
limits: This tests the regular paired variant. Exact Android device motion, colors and shadow appearance remain unverified.

references.scope: Vertical FAB top/bottom placement and expansion geometry.

validation: Rust test covers vertical expanded/collapsed geometry, top/bottom placement and RTL.
